summary: US stocks ended mixed-to-higher on election day, 3 Nov: the S&P 500 rose about 0.3% to 7,568.9 and the Nasdaq 0.8% as chips rebounded, while the Dow fell 0.4%; the 10-year yield rose to about 4.96%. Brent settled near $103.60 and WTI near $96 after two down sessions, with US-Iran signals still mixed and OPEC+ holding December quotas. The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate to 4.85% on a 6-3 vote. In Asia, MediaTek fell 7.4% and SK Hynix 5.0% in Taiwan and Seoul, and Cyclone Murasu made landfall in India's Andhra Pradesh. Apple weighed on tech after guiding a lower gross margin, DuPont rose 8.6% on results, and EU gas storage was near 74.6% full.

climate.headline: EU gas storage near 74.6% full and falling, about 11 points under the five-year average
